title: Umami Farfallini Fritters
description: A simple, crispy fritter recipe using umami and farfallini. Perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk eggs and add flour.
Add grated Parmesan and umami. Mix well.
Add the farfallini and mix until the pasta is well coated.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls.
Heat a pan with oil over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add the balls and flatten them slightly.
Fry until golden brown (about 3 minutes per side).
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
